summary: LTP on NSE cash: the web test's MarketFeedV3 frame gives ltp with 5paisa's TickDt as ltt; a frame whose TickDt is DateTime.MinValue leaves ltt out; after the unsubscribe a late frame reaches nobody.

notes: FEED is the web test's frame; the second frame is FEED with TickDt /Date(-62135596800000)/, as test_negative_tickdt_omits_ltt sends it.

deviations.reason: The 5paisa web adapter puts its subscription mode number (1, 2, 3) in data.mode; the desktop sends its label (ltp, quote, full). Follows the web adapter in Phase B through lane wire's per-broker switch in the dialect table (5paisa: the number).
